ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a tripolar grid type.
description: This horizontal grid cell describes the y-velocity (V-point) staggered location of the MOM6 tripolar ocean grid, sharing the same longitude structure as the mass (h-point) grid g260 (360 points), but offset by half a grid cell northward in latitude. This yields 313 latitude rows — one more than g260 — including an additional row at the southern edge (-90°). The resulting grid has 360 x 313 = 112,680 cells. The tripolar fold is positioned at 65°N, consistent with g260.
